title: Frozen collision-pair future-probe predictive ambiguity adjudication
purpose: Test whether discovery states that are indistinguishable at the preregistered candidate-coordinate collision scale produce distinguishable future storage responses under identical frozen probes, without changing collision pairs, probes, horizons, coordinate definitions, or Reference policy after outcomes are observed.

full_state_control.role: state-separating discovery control only; no collision-pair future probes because no frozen Z16 collision manifest exists

starting_state_reconstruction.state_identity: exact history and accepted step from frozen B1 manifest
starting_state_reconstruction.reconstruction_policy: ROM1AR2 frozen strict-first discovery-qualified research Reference policy
starting_state_reconstruction.probe_lineage: new committed lineage rebased to t=0 from the reconstructed accepted physical state
starting_state_reconstruction.reason: future-probe comparison is conditional on the accepted physical starting state, not prior nonlinear solver scratch

reference_policy.local_balance_fallback: only zero-head-flag RETRY_LOCAL_BALANCE within independently frozen 1.6e-15 cm integrated local allowance and pre-solve total representation bound

predictive_response_definition.reason: removes the small allowed initial candidate-coordinate difference from the future-response test and isolates hidden-state-dependent evolution

numerical_reference_scales.source_rule: maximum B01 value already measured before B2 across ROM-0T1Q1 temporal and ROM-0V1 vertical Reference-floor evidence

pairwise_response_separation_scales.rule: 2 * single-trajectory Reference scale by triangle-inequality conservatism for two independent future trajectories

formal_predictive_ambiguity.record_is_ambiguous_if: any of total, upper-0-40, or lower-40-160 pair response differences exceeds its frozen pairwise response separation scale
formal_predictive_ambiguity.coordinate_has_discovery_ambiguity_if: at least one of its 8 frozen pairs under any frozen discovery probe at any frozen horizon is ambiguous

exchange_outputs.reason: the existing ROM-0 fixed-flux floor does not provide an independently informative state-dependent prescribed-head exchange floor
exchange_outputs.if_storage_survivor_exists: a later separately preregistered exchange-floor/evaluation gate is required before any claim of complete predictive sufficiency

next_rule.if_all_Z1_Z2_Z4_Z8_have_storage_ambiguit: close this nested water-content aggregation hierarchy as discovery-insufficient and preregister discovery-only coordinate enrichment; held-out histories remain sealed until a new candidate is frozen
next_rule.if_any_reduced_coordinate_has_zero_stora: freeze the survivor set before any held-out use; separately resolve exchange-output floor before a complete predictive-sufficiency claim
